briefTitle: Adagrasib + SRS for Patients With Metastatic KRAS G12C-mutated NSCLC With Untreated Brain Metastases

typedChecks.sourceText: Age ≥ 18 years at the time of consent.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Age ≥ 18 years at the time of consent.

typedChecks.sourceText: ECOG Performance Status of 0-1 within 28 days prior to registration.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: ECOG Performance Status of 0-1 within 28 days prior to registration.

typedChecks.sourceText: Patients may be treatment-naïve OR have received up to 2 prior lines of systemic therapy.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Patients may be treatment-naïve OR have received up to 2 prior lines of systemic therapy.

typedChecks.sourceText: Hemoglobin (Hgb): ≥ 8.0 g/dL in the absence of transfusions within 7 days prior to testing.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Hemoglobin (Hgb): ≥ 8.0 g/dL in the absence of transfusions within 7 days prior to testing.

typedChecks.sourceText: Calculated creatinine clearance: ≥ 60 mL/min
Bilirubin: ≤ 1.5 mg/dL
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST): ≤ 3.0 × ULN
Alanine aminotransferase (ALT): ≤ 3.0 × ULN

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must have no single metastasis measuring larger than 3 cm.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Size limits on brain metastases are specific anatomical criteria not mapped to standard brain_mets categories.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Symptomatic brain metastases are permitted if the following criteria are met: No evidence of cerebral herniation or symptomatic leptomeningeal disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex neurological criteria and symptom restrictions are judgment-based.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prolonged QTc interval > 480 milliseconds or history of congenital Long QT Syndrome
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: QTc interval cutoff is a specific cardiac metric not covered by the standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Symptomatic brain metastases are permitted if the following criteria are met: No evidence of cerebral herniation or symptomatic leptomeningeal disease No seizures within past 14 days; antiepileptic medications are permitted Patients on steroids must have stable or improving neurologic symptoms that have not worsened during a steroid taper. Must be receiving the equivalent of dexamethasone 8 mg total daily dose or less at the time of registration.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Detailed symptom, seizure, and steroid conditions for brain metastases require subjective clinical evaluation.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Confirmation of stage IV non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) per AJCC, 8th edition, or metastatic recurrence after treatment for earlier stage disease.
